title: 京都东山一日步行（12/12 周六）
prompt: 12 月 12 日（周六）我在京都，住京都站附近，想一个人步行逛东山一带一天：清水寺、二年坂三年坂、八坂神社这些，帮我排个一日行程页。
prompt_en: On Saturday 12 December I'll be in Kyoto, staying near Kyoto Station. I want to spend a day walking around Higashiyama on my own: Kiyomizu-dera, Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine and so on. Please put together a one-day itinerary page for me.
